spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:8:7: command demo: flag "name": sets `layout` but its type is string; a layout says how a time is written, so it applies to time, datetime and date
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:13:7: command demo: flag "due": sets `layout` "YYYY-MM-DD", which contains no part of Go's reference time, so no value could ever match; Go layouts write the reference time Mon Jan 2 15:04:05 MST 2006 the way yours is, e.g. "2006-01-02" for a date (or use unix / unixmilli)
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:52:7: command demo: flag "bad": sets `layout` "YYYY", which contains no part of Go's reference time, so no value could ever match; Go layouts write the reference time Mon Jan 2 15:04:05 MST 2006 the way yours is, e.g. "2006-01-02" for a date (or use unix / unixmilli)
warning: spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:47:7: command demo: flag "year": lists `layout` "2006" after "unix", which also reads its values, as a different time; "2006" is never reached for them, so list the more specific layout first
